ex.en: He is now either in Rome or in Paris.
ex.zh: 他現在不是在羅馬就是在巴黎。

ex.en: Let’s either speak Chinese, or not speak at all.
ex.zh: 我們要嘛說中文，要嘛就別說話。

either.en: used to show that there are two possible choices

ex.en: Tom, if you're not going, I'm not going either.
ex.zh: 湯姆，如果你不去，我也不去。

ex.en: I don't know why the meeting was postponed, either.
ex.zh: 我也不知道為什麼會議延期了。

either.en: used after a negative statement to mean also

ex.en: You can reach the park by either road.
ex.zh: 兩條路都可以到公園。

ex.en: There are many stores on either side of the street.
ex.zh: 街道兩旁有很多商店。

either.en: one or the other of two things, or both of them

ex.en: I sleep for about eight hours every night.
ex.zh: 我每晚大約睡八個小時。

ex.en: The shop opens at eight in the morning.
ex.zh: 這家店早上八點開門。

ex.en: There are eight people in her family.
ex.zh: 她家裡有八個人。

ex.en: My grandmother is eighty years old and still walks every day.
ex.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，還是每天散步。

ex.en: The shirt cost eighty dollars on sale.
ex.zh: 這件襯衫特價賣八十元。

ex.en: Eighty people signed up for the free class.
ex.zh: 有八十個人報名了這堂免費課程。

ex.en: In many countries, people become adults at eighteen.
ex.zh: 在許多國家，人在十八歲成年。

ex.en: The class has eighteen students this semester.
ex.zh: 這學期班上有十八名學生。

ex.en: The bus arrives at eighteen minutes past nine.
ex.zh: 公車九點十八分到站。

ex.en: Her eighteenth birthday party was held at a small restaurant.
ex.zh: 她的十八歲生日派對在一間小餐廳舉行。

ex.en: He finished in eighteenth place in the race.
ex.zh: 他在比賽中拿到第十八名。

ex.en: An eighteenth of the budget goes to office supplies.
ex.zh: 預算的十八分之一用在辦公用品上。

ex.en: Each person received one eighteenth of the prize money.
ex.zh: 每個人拿到獎金的十八分之一。

ex.en: Our office is on the eighth floor.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在八樓。

ex.en: She came in eighth in the swimming race.
ex.zh: 她在游泳比賽中得到第八名。

ex.en: Today is the eighth day of our trip.
ex.zh: 今天是我們旅行的第八天。
